title: Palula language
description: Indo-Aryan language spoken in the Chitral District Pakistan
extract: Palula and also known as Ashreti (Aćharêtâʹ) or Dangarikwar, is an Indo-Aryan language spoken by approximately 10,000 people in the valleys of Ashret and Biori, as well as in the village of Puri in the Shishi valley and at least by a portion of the population in the village Kalkatak, in the Lower Chitral District of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province of Pakistan.
